lines: судъ покажути, нє при доменю на
notes: Card appears upside down in image. Orthography shows 17th century Ukrainian sources style - uses є predominantly. Some letters are challenging due to handwriting style - particularly the last line where words like 'нєсємкі' and 'кутулі' have unusual forms. 'Дри котормъ' may be 'Дри которомъ' with missing letter. 'ботова боза' is uncertain reading.
